config.simple.title: Common settings
config.simple.hint: Leave a box empty to use the standard value again. The device reads the file as soon as you save it, so you do not have to restart it. A service that is already running keeps its old value only if it does not listen for configuration changes.
config.raw.title: Your configuration file
config.raw.hint.pre: This is your own layer of

config.saved.notLive: The running services could not be told, so this is not live yet; it takes effect when the device is next restarted.
config.confirm.saveRaw: Replace your configuration with this text? The old file is kept as a backup.
